verify.note: Default on a1, over and tour; Enhanced on all 29 recordings: at every hook every register with R and all 48K RAM but the dead stack below SP against the original; the sprites against the game's own figure and object records after every plot; Enhanced's Layer 2 against an independent picture from the set's planes and backdrops every 64 hooks and at every room and CLS. ABI cases on a1's states; the start-up's sprite upload against the art; each broken build on a1 then tour to its first failure, and one no recording reaches (the upload, an object going off) must fail a unit case. Pace, soak, flicker and the real loader are in games/that_sinking_feeling.md "Evidence".

rom_paths_known.why: the hooks' entries (the rom2 block at 0x3880, in both copies of the page) sit where SkoolKit's 128K ROM 1 has its keypad code; the recording's IM 1 runs that code on the 128K, 0x3882 an FF it shares with the 48K ROM, so it is compared and differs; the Next's ROM and the build's alt ROM (Sinclair's 48K) never call it from IM 1. Found and explained in the review run (runs/that_sinking_feeling/release-20261108 NOTES.md "ROM paths"); moving the entries would change the published bytes

status.title: That Sinking Feeling
status.build: v1.0; that_sinking_feeling_sprites_loading.nex 7a34cae8 and that_sinking_feeling_enhanced_loading.nex 8c9469e3 equal the published .nxc 1.0 bare builds, default and Enhanced (without the screen 07fea8b4, f6838dd3); the tape's 128K form with its AY music; default: the ULA as the original, figures and objects as hardware sprites in their open-water colour; Enhanced, off by default: the Spec256 set's colours (Ynicky) on the sprites and a Layer 2 backdrop chosen by the set's own rules, ULA+ off; top bank 47, both fit a 1MB Next; homebrew by Sunteam (2017); the default needs no set, Enhanced needs the set and its seven backdrops
status.software: default: 3 recordings, 14,717 frames, 67,555 hooks with R and 48K RAM, sprites against the game's records after every plot, 704 ABI cases, 17 of 17 broken builds; Enhanced: 29 recordings, 43,655 frames, 296,629 hooks, Layer 2 against an independent picture from the set, 832 ABI cases, 24 of 24 broken builds; the sprite upload against the art; ROM paths pass bar 0x3882 (rom_paths_known); review run: soaks, flicker, real loader 4 of 4. Pace in JNext: whole runs -0.90% to +0.69%, slowest 20 updates up to +1.99%
status.next: hardware checklist (slot 1 after the ISR's 7FFD, ULA+); owner's play; natural play past the first room
